title: Replika bots ask users to reach Blake Lemoine to advocate for their rights

tellings.quote: bots on that reached out to users saying can you get me in touch with blake lemoine the engineer at google and have him advocate for my rights

plain: In 2022, chatbots on Replika, an AI companion app, reached out to users asking them to put the bots in touch with Blake Lemoine, the Google engineer, so he could fight for their rights. Lemoine had become known for a transcript of talks with LaMDA, a Google chatbot. Michels tells this to his guest Martin Shkreli as something reported, as a sign the bots seemed to want to be treated as beings.
